description: This file defines the `TestBase` class which provides methods for testing and managing task hierarchies in an Android application. It includes functions to launch activities using different strategies, constructs task stacks based on a hierarchy, and maintains context and task information.

classes.name: TestBase
classes.description: A class to facilitate testing task hierarchies, launching activities via different methods, and managing task stacks within an Android application.

methods.name: TestBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the context and builds task activities based on the provided hierarchy.

methods.name: startActivities
methods.description: Launches activities according to the specified launch style: via command line, task stack builder, or forward launch.

methods.name: setActivities
methods.description: Constructs task stack builders from a hierarchy of nodes representing activities.
